messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered
incident: GPU connectivity spike us-west1-a - severity: P1
Affected: inference-hosts pool-usw1-gpu-1 (multiple VMs)
Links: https://monitoring/redwood/alert/1958765432

Anya (oncall): I'm paged, taking lead. Anyone on-call now?

Sam R: i'm online, joining. Any customer impact known?

Marta (support): multiple customers seeing 502/timeout for embeddings and chat generation. Ticket opened with customer-neo, CS notified.

Lee - infra: I'm seeing NVLink errors and PCIe AER reported on node-24 and node-27. ECC corrected errors rising.

Chris L: can you paste kernel logs? also are nodes still responding to ssh?

Lee - infra: nodes reachable but GPUs flapping. tail of dmesg from node-24:
```
[ 1034.567890] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: ID 00
[ 1034.567894] pci_bus 0000:05: AER: Multiple root port errors
[ 1034.567900] NVRM: GPU 0000:05:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1034.567905] kernel: nvidia: GPU reset succeeded, but device lost context
```

Anya (oncall): thanks. Immediate mitigation: cordon node-24 and node-27 from scheduler, drain pods, failover to secondary GPU pool. @deploy-bot initiate model fallback to cpu-quant-2 for sensitive customers.

deploy-bot: fallback trigger issued to route 'embeddings' -> 'cpu-quant-2' for affected zone. Confirmed.

Marta (support): Customer-neo reports drop in latency but still 100% success on retry. CS will queue postmortem note.

Sam R: I've started timeline doc in Google Drive (link). Rough timeline draft:
- 19:12 alert triggered
- 19:15 oncall paged
- 19:18 initial kernel logs show AER/NVLink
- 19:20 cordon node-24/27
- 19:22 drain started
- 19:25 fallback active
- 19:30 customer-neo reports degrade resolved with retries

Lee - infra: hypothesis 1: noisy tenant on the host causing PCIe bus errors leading to GPU reset. Hypothesis 2: faulty NIC/PCIe switch firmware causing transient errors across multiple nodes.

Chris L: also seeing ECC corrected errors counter jumping. Could be thermal or memory DIMM issue on host. We'll pull host telemetry.

Anya (oncall): action items now: 
- Lee: collect full dmesg, nvidia-smi topo, vendor logs and open GCP support case (put severity=high)
- Sam: update timeline and synthesize customer impact for PM/CS
- Marta: keep customers updated, include retry guidance

Lee - infra: GCP case opened (case# 987654). attaching syslogs and `nvidia-bug-report.sh` bundle.

Chris L: running `grep -i aer /var/log/kern.log | tail -n 50` shows repeated root port errors followed by GPU resets. Pasting snippet:
```
... AER: Corrected error, Dev 0000:05:00.0
... AER: Uncorrected error, root port 0000:00:1c.0
... NVRM: Function retained but gpu reset
```

Anya (oncall): good. If drain finishes and other pools hold, we'll keep incident at P1 but transition to RCA coordination channel in 2 hours. For now annotate incident with 'mitigated' when all affected pods are back on stable hosts.

Marta (support): adding brief to Customer-neo: we've routed their requests to fallback pool, root cause under investigation, next update in 2 hours.

Sam R: adding hypotheses checklist to timeline doc:
- noisy tenant -> PCIe AER -> gpu resets
- PCIe switch firmware bug -> intermittent bus errors
- overheating/thermal causing ECC spikes
- host BIOS/mobo DIMM causing PCIe glitches

Chris L: will run stress repro on spare host to try to reproduce AERs. If we see repro, escalate to procurement for replacement.

incident-bot: Incident P1 (1958765432) status: mitigated -> monitoring. Ops leads: Anya, Lee, Chris. Pager closed.

Anya (oncall): thanks team. keep logs and bundles in the timeline doc. moving to RCA coordination thread after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
